title: fida racmatta oggolimte
intro: isi intiita aliffa hayteh taswiir fidin, tibba le golo amanti waado fan gibbata. Atu celtam duude wayta amrih foocal sabhalal le xayyos uddur gibbati ammirtimiyyaa kee yallih racmatta amotani astah korse.
clues: Anu Qur'aanak kassitah too sabrit coolayse marak fanak.
Anu Yallih amrih rammit gibbata mablak gudet suge.
mabla yoh warsen wak, anu excem elle amrisen innal abam kee atu yoo geetto lakmisa marih fanak.
Anu fidaah xiineh suge, takkay immay Yalli seeceh too mabla kibbimteh.
Yalli kaxxa fida yoo fideh, sarrimaane horal yoh cabe.
Anu Ismaaqil, Ibraahim luk, Idris kee Dhul-Kifl luk, diggalsimeh yan marih fanat, qimmoh addah qimmise.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Yallih idinil raboytit mano fan seecaanama.
tellemmoh addat qeedaalisso kee qeedaalisso ganaanama

outcome.answer: Sabri kee meqe farmoytit fanat faatit le.

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
